title: Oil Infused Indian Tahini Curry
description: A nutty and light Maharashtrian dish featuring tahini paste, this curry is perfect for festive occasions and is kosher-friendly, prepared in a copper pot.
instructions: Heat the vegetable oil in a copper pot over medium heat.
Add the cumin seeds and let them sizzle for a few seconds.
Add the chopped onion and saute until it is translucent.
Add the minced garlic and grated ginger and saute for another minute.
Add the curry leaves and saute for a few seconds.
Add the roasted tahini paste and stir well to combine.
Add the salt and water, and stir well to combine.
Bring the mixture to a simmer and let it cook for 10 minutes.
Stir the curry occasionally to prevent it from sticking to the pot.
Remove the pot from the heat and let the curry cool slightly.
